No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Floating meadow island with pink blossom trees, small curved paths/ponds, waterfalls at the rim and a tiny indistinct white figure under the Unicorn Meadow title. The figure is too small to establish animal anatomy. Hidden layout inference: A sky arrival leads to an open flower meadow, a small wish pond and a blossom-tree loop with two quiet rim overlooks. Keep a generous soft focal clearing for the unicorn rather than adding another castle or stables/service complex. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "S04-ARTIFACT-001 — Unicorn Meadow — site artifact sections".
